ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, November 13, 2017 and to business minors on Monday, November 20, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to ISE students on Monday, November 27, 2017 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
